messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: [PAGER] high error rate (502) on /v1/generate in us-west-2 — smartroute fallback triggering multiple region hops (policy=prefer-low-latency)
Olivia Chen: I'm looking. Are we seeing the fallback loop from us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-west-2?
Samir Patel: yes, traces show requests keep switching region after model variant mismatch. routing policy keeps selecting variant v3-quant on fail which isn't compatible with current compiled kernels.
Mike Nguyen: paging Samir (oncall) — can you confirm if a manual override was applied?
Samir Patel: I just got paged. Checking audit logs now.
Infra Bot: Audit: user=Kevin.R action=force_route params={region: "eu-west-1", model_variant: "v3-quant"} by CLI at 1965432068
Kevin R.: that was me — I forced eu-west-1 to drain for a storage incident, tried to pin a model variant to avoid cold starts. didn't expect global routing policy to start cascading. sorry.
Olivia Chen: that explains it. Forcing incompatible variant caused continuous fallback because the KV cache keys aren't compatible across quantization formats.
Samir Patel: consequences: elevated 502s, latency spikes, retries, and model pool exhaustion in both regions. customer impact: several high-volume customers saw degraded responses and timeouts for 8-10 minutes so far.
Sara L.: any immediate mitigation we can do besides reverting?
Mike Nguyen: revert the force_route (Kevin), and put a temporary route-policy override to refuse auto-fallback to v3-quant. Also add a 30s retry-backoff.
Kevin R.: I'm reverting now:
```
# revert force-route applied by me
redwoodctl routing revert --id=force-1965432068 --confirm
```
Olivia Chen: after revert we should also disable the cross-region auto-fallback for the policy responsible. Samir, can you apply a temporary guard?
Samir Patel: applying guard now. setting policy `prefer-low-latency` to not fallback across regions for models with variant mismatch.
Infra Bot: Command executed by Samir.Patel at 1965432345: `policy update prefer-low-latency --no-cross-region-fallback --duration=15m`
Mike Nguyen: we should throttle incoming traffic to the affected model route to stop the retry storm. adding rate limit on /v1/generate route to 300rps for demo tier and 1200rps global.
Olivia Chen: starting incident bridge — dialing 10-digit bridge. Folks in the bridge: Olivia, Samir, Mike, Kevin, Sara.
Samir Patel: guard applied. Early metrics: error rate dropping from 8% -> 2% over the last 90s.
Kevin R.: sorry again — note to self: don't force a variant incompatible with the global model catalog. I'll open a change request for safer pin flow.
Sara L.: we should notify customers affected. Who owns comms? I'll draft a short note: outage window, affected endpoints, mitigation steps, follow-up.
Olivia Chen: Ops: collect sample traces for affected requests and save KV cache dump for forensic analysis (don't delete). Mike, can you fetch pool metrics and memory errors?
Mike Nguyen: on it. pulling logs and pool OOM stats. found frequent "kv_cache_miss" and "quant-decode: unsupported-format" in eu-west-1 logs.
Samir Patel: rolling back the variant pin prevented further incompatibility but we need a controlled rollout path: ensure model compilation compatibility check before force-routing.
Infra Bot: Incident severity escalated to Sev2 at 1965432410 by Olivia Chen
Olivia Chen: timeline note: root cause = manual force_route to eu-west-1 with model_variant v3-quant that lacked cross-region compatibility causing smart-routing to loop retries and cascade load.
Kevin R.: what next steps? I can own the immediate PR to disable CLI force-route for incompatible variants and add a safety-check.
Samir Patel: I'll add a runtime check: before applying a force-route, verify model binary compatibility across regions; if mismatch, block and warn.
Sara L.: comms draft ready — short advisory, ETA for full postmortem in 48h. I will send to oncall-consumers list after Olivia signs off.
Olivia Chen: pls post a short initial message to status.redwood.ai that we've mitigated and are investigating root cause; include affected endpoints and customer contact for critical cases.
Samir Patel: final metric snapshot: error rate <1% now, latency back to baseline. Keeping policy guard for 15m, will extend if stable.
Mike Nguyen: created ticket INF-4219 to track cache compatibility tests and rollout gating.
Kevin R.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/812 — adds pre-checks and blocks unsafe force-route.
Olivia Chen: good. After bridge we should run a short post-incident checklist: owner assignment (Kevin for fix PR, Samir for policy enforcement, Mike for telemetry), customer comms (Sara), and a blameless postmortem.
Sara L.: assigned and noted in ticket. I'll coordinate with CS for affected customer outreach.
Samir Patel: removing guard in 15m if stable; leaving a temp playbook note: `if you must force-route, confirm variant compatibility and pre-warm caches`
Olivia Chen: thanks all. moving to retrospective. closing bridge in 5. :thumbsup:
Infra Bot: Incident closed at 1965432980 — mitigation validated, follow-ups assigned.
